text:
AR373
Advanced Bioarchaeology
0.5 Credit
Hours per week:
Lecture/Discussion: 3
This
course
aims to provide
students
with advanced training in the theory and method of
bioarchaeology. The focus of the course will vary from
term
to term and may include
emphasis on paleopathology, paleodiet, DNA studies, stable isotope
analysis, paleodemography, juvenile osteology, etc.
Additional Course Information
Prerequisites
AR370
